method: Stances are coded only from what each manifesto says. “Silent” means the document makes no commitment on that statement — not that the party opposes it. Page numbers are the printed page numbers.
excluded: AAP, AITC and CPI(M) are not included yet: we could not verify their positions against their own documents.

statements.text: Minimum Support Price for crops should be guaranteed by law.

bjp.quote: We have ensured unprecedented increase in MSP for major crops, and we will continue to increase MSP from time to time.

inc.quote: Congress will give a legal guarantee to the Minimum Support Prices (MSP) announced by the government every year, as recommended by the Swaminathan Commission.

statements.text: Lok Sabha and state assembly elections should be held at the same time.

bjp.quote: Making One Nation, One Election a Reality … will work towards the implementation of the recommendations of the Committee.
bjp.verify: Reconstructed from a page that extracts poorly; check against the PDF.

inc.quote: We reject the ‘one nation one election’ idea and we promise that elections to the Lok Sabha and the State Assemblies will be held as and when they are due.

statements.text: India should adopt a Uniform Civil Code.

bjp.quote: BJP reiterates its stand to draw a Uniform Civil Code, drawing upon the best traditions and harmonising them with the modern times.

inc.quote: We will encourage reform of personal laws. Such reform must be undertaken with the participation and consent of the communities concerned.

statements.text: A nationwide caste census should be conducted.

inc.quote: Congress will conduct a nation-wide Socio-Economic and Caste Census to enumerate the castes and sub-castes and their socio-economic conditions.

statements.text: The Agnipath short-term military recruitment scheme should be scrapped.

inc.quote: Congress will scrap the Agnipath Scheme and return to the normal recruitment processes followed by the Army, Navy and Air Force.

statements.text: Women’s reservation in legislatures should start without waiting for a new census and delimitation.

bjp.quote: We will systematically implement this to ensure representation for women in the Parliament and State Legislatures.

inc.quote: Congress will delete the sinister provisions and bring the Amendment Act into force immediately … applied to the Lok Sabha that will be elected in 2029.

statements.text: There should be strict legal action against exam paper leaks.

bjp.quote: We have already enacted a strict law to stop misconduct in recruitment exams across the country. We will strictly implement this law.

inc.quote: We will provide fast-track courts to adjudicate cases of leaking question papers for job examinations and provide monetary compensation to the victims.

statements.text: Poor households should get free electricity.

bjp.quote: Zero Electricity Bill – We will provide free electricity to poor households under PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana.

statements.text: Poor families should get a direct annual cash transfer to a woman of the household.

inc.quote: Congress resolves to launch a Mahalakshmi scheme to provide ₹1 lakh per year to every poor Indian family as an unconditional cash transfer.

statements.text: The GST system should be restructured.

bjp.quote: We will further simplify the GST portal to increase accessibility to users, especially MSMEs and small traders.

inc.quote: The GST Council will be re-designed. It will be the final authority on policy and on all matters relating to GST.

statements.text: Full statehood should be restored to Jammu & Kashmir.

inc.quote: We will immediately restore full statehood to Jammu and Kashmir.

statements.text: Young graduates should have a legal right to a paid apprenticeship.

inc.quote: Congress guarantees a new Right to Apprenticeship Act to provide a one year apprenticeship … to every diploma holder or college graduate below the age of 25.
